What is slicing and how does negative indexing work?

Supplied answer
Slicing takes a part of a sequence using [start:stop:step]. The stop index is never included. Negative
indexes count from the end: s[-1] is the last item, s[-2] the second last. s[::-1] reverses the sequence, and
s[:] makes a shallow copy.
